chunks: 4659 - And in the narration of al-Sakūnī, from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father عليه السلام, he said:
“There is no harm in a man looking at the hair of his mother, his sister, or his daughter.”

key_terms.السَّكُونِيِّ: al-Sakūnī, the narrator transmitting this report
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; an expression of permissibility

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a man to look at the hair of his mother, sister, or daughter in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a man's looking at the hair of certain close mahram female relatives. It indicates the permissibility of this within immediate family relations such as one's mother, sister, and daughter.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4659 - In the narration of Al-Sakooni from Ja'far ibn Muhammad from his father (as), he said: "
There is no harm for a man to look at the hair of his mother, his sister, or his daughter."
